title: docs: overhaul ROADMAP.md — condense completed work, refocus on component quality and DX
body:
ROADMAP.md was 700 lines of mostly-checked checkboxes with priorities scattered across marketplace, cloud, and platform vision items. Needed refocusing: short-term goal is component usability, console completeness, developer experience, and documentation — not marketplace or cloud.

**Completed milestones condensed** (700 → 296 lines)
- Q1–Q3 2026, Console v1.0, v3.0.0 integration, designer completion — all reduced from ~200 individual `[x]` checkboxes to paragraph summaries
- Architecture diagram preserved

**New priority structure (P1–P4)**
- **P1 Component Excellence** — audit 91+ components for API consistency, field widget polish, view robustness, Storybook coverage, test gaps
- **P2 Console Completeness** — eliminate hand-wired ObjectView duplication, replace local adapter with `data-objectstack`, fix Chinese strings, schema-driven views, full CRUD verification
- **P3 Developer Experience** — zero-to-app in 10 min, CLI tooling, error messages, API simplification
- **P4 Documentation** — package READMEs, guides, API reference, Storybook as living docs

**Deferred to Future Vision**
- Plugin marketplace, community growth, ObjectUI Cloud, industry solutions — briefly listed, explicitly out of current scope

**Added success metrics table**

| Metric | Current | Target |
|--------|---------|--------|
| Test Coverage | 80% | 90% |
| Storybook Stories | 66 | 91+ |
| Console Gaps | ~8 | 0 |
